title: n8n + Gemini: every website lead qualified, booked or declined #shorts
description:
One n8n workflow answers every book-a-call form on your website. n8n serves the form itself. Gemini reads each message against one sentence you wrote and decides qualified or not. Qualified: a 30-minute call lands on your Google Calendar with the lead as guest, and Gmail sends the confirmation. Not qualified: a polite decline that invites them to reply if things change.

The importable workflow and the node-by-node wiring notes are in the community: https://www.skool.com/nijoson-bosco-3533

You need n8n, a Google account (Gmail and Calendar) and a Gemini key from Google AI Studio.

#n8n #automation #leadqualification #googlecalendar #gemini
